home.tagline: Ship your SaaS in days, not months.
home.seoTitle: SaaS Template — Ship your SaaS faster
home.seoDescription: SaaS Template ships Better Auth, Stripe billing, Supabase Postgres, and a demo Notes feature.
home.featureAuthBody: Email/password and Google sign-in via Better Auth, with session gating on the dashboard.
home.featureBillingBody: Stripe checkout, customer portal, and webhooks keep your Postgres profile in sync.
home.featureDemoBody: Notes shows real auth + billing gating end to end — swap it for your product.
home.featurePushBody: Web push with VAPID keys and an SSRF-safe endpoint allowlist, ready to use.
home.featurePwaBody: Installable on iOS and Android with a guided install tutorial.
home.featureDeployBody: Supabase Postgres + Drizzle ORM, Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights included.
